given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator or Store Partner initiates an Order Request against a Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The Store Partner Agreement is marked as inactive or superseded
given_when_then.then: The system prevents the execution of the order and blocks allocation to the partner

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner attempts to allocate an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system validates the associated Store Partner Agreement status
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the allocation if the agreement is inactive or marked as superseded

given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator creates a new version of a Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: An amendment is applied to an active agreement
given_when_then.then: The previous agreement version is automatically marked as historical and the new version becomes active

given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator or Store Partner attempts to delete a Store Partner Agreement version
given_when_then.when: The agreement version has already been created
given_when_then.then: The system prevents the deletion of the agreement version

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner attempts to allocate an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The associated Store Partner Agreement is marked as inactive
given_when_then.then: The system prevents the creation of the Delivery Assignment

success_criteria: Order Requests are not executed against Store Partner Agreements marked as inactive or superseded
New agreement versions are created with incremented version numbers when amendments are made to active agreements
Previous agreement versions are automatically archived as historical data upon amendment
Deletion of any agreement version is blocked once it has been created
Order allocations are rejected when the associated agreement is inactive
Delivery Assignments are not created for orders allocated to partners with inactive agreements
Only the Platform Operator and the Store Partner have access to edit their respective agreement versions
